period_present.fail: Claim {claim} has no period end date, so it cannot be placed in order among the contract's claims
period_present.suggestion: Enter the last day of the period this claim covers

period_order.fail: Claim {claim} starts on {period_from} and ends on {period_to}, so its period ends before it begins
period_order.suggestion: Correct the period start or end so the start comes first

period_overlap.fail: Claim {claim} starts on {period_from}, but the previous claim {previous} runs to {previous_to}, so both claims bill the same days
period_overlap.suggestion: Start this claim on the day after the previous claim's period ends

period_gap.fail: Claim {claim} starts on {period_from}, but the previous claim {previous} ended on {previous_to}, so no claim bills the days in between (unbilled days: {days})
period_gap.suggestion: Start this claim on the day after the previous claim's period ends, or check that a claim is not missing

period_unparsed.fail: Claim {claim} records the {field} as '{value}', which cannot be read as a date
period_unparsed.suggestion: Enter the date as year, month and day, for example 2026-03-31

line_overbilled.fail: Line {line} is billed at {billed} to date, more than its scheduled value of {scheduled}; run Populate from progress again or lower this period's amount on the line
line_overbilled.suggestion: Populate from progress bills each line only for what is new since the earlier claims. If the line's scope really grew, record the change order that increases its scheduled value first

percent_regressed.fail: Line {line} is at {percent}% complete to date, which is {requested}, less than the {previous} the earlier claims already billed on it, so nothing is billed on it this period
percent_regressed.suggestion: Check the percent complete on this line, or correct the earlier claim that overstated it

errors.submission_blocked: This payment application cannot be submitted until these are resolved: {findings}
errors.rules_unavailable: The payment application rules are not loaded on this deployment, so this claim cannot be checked before it is submitted.
errors.later_claim_already_issued: Claim {claims} comes after this one and has already gone out. It was built while this claim was a draft, so it already applies for this work. Delete this draft, or move its period after the last claim that went out

totals_match_lines.fail: Claim {claim} asks for {gross}, but the lines behind it add up to {lines_total}: the claim was not worked out again after its lines changed
totals_match_lines.suggestion: Save any line of this claim, or run Populate from progress again, and its totals follow

totals_below_lines.fail: Claim {claim} bills {gross} from recorded cost, less than the {lines_total} its own lines add up to: the breakdown cannot ask for more than the claim does
totals_below_lines.suggestion: On a claim billed from cost the lines are a breakdown of the money, not the source of it. Lower or remove the lines that overstate it, or generate the claim again from the cost of work so the two agree

prior_matches_earlier_claims.line_fail: Claim {claim} carries {stored} as previously billed on line {line}, but the earlier claims bill {now} on it now
prior_matches_earlier_claims.total_fail: Claim {claim} carries {stored} as previously certified, but the earlier claims certify {now} now
prior_matches_earlier_claims.suggestion: Generate this claim again so it reads what the claims before it bill today

within_nte_cap.fail: Claim {claim} bills {this} on top of the {billed} already billed, which is over the not-to-exceed cap of {cap}
within_nte_cap.suggestion: Bill up to the cap on this claim and agree a change order for the rest

retention_matches_policy.fail: Claim {claim} holds {held} in retention, but its retention policy gives {expected} now: an earlier claim, a release or the policy changed after this claim was worked out
retention_matches_policy.suggestion: Run Populate from progress again, or save any line of this claim, and its retention is worked out again

retention_above_cap.fail: Claim {claim} holds {held} in retention, above the {percent}% cap its retention policy sets, which is {cap} on this contract
retention_above_cap.suggestion: Work the claim out again, or raise the cap on the contract's retention policy if the parties agreed a higher one
retention_above_cap.state_cap_unread: Claim {claim}: its retention policy sets no cap, and {country} limits retainage by state law. No state could be resolved because the project carries no subdivision code, so no statutory cap was checked
retention_above_cap.state_cap_suggestion: Write the state's limit into the contract's retention policy as a cap, and every claim on this contract is checked against it

retention_release_within_held.fail: The releases billed up to claim {claim} pay back {released}, more than the {accrued} of retention held up to it
retention_release_within_held.suggestion: Void the release that is too large, or bill it on a later claim once more retention is held

sov_reconciles_contract_sum.fail: The schedule of values adds up to {scheduled}, but the contract sum to date is {contract_sum}: the lines this claim is billed against leave {difference} of the contract without a line
sov_reconciles_contract_sum.suggestion: Add or correct schedule of values lines until they add up to the contract sum
sov_reconciles_contract_sum.suggestion_reconcile: {count} approved change orders or variations moved the contract sum before they reached the schedule of values. Use Reconcile change orders on the contract to add a line for each

documents_attached.fail: This release needs the {document}, and none is attached
documents_attached.suggestion: Register the document on the contract, attach it to the release and approve it again

within_available.fail: This release pays back {amount}, but only {available} of retention is still held and not committed to another release
within_available.suggestion: Void this release and propose it again, so it is sized on the retention held now

release_period_elapsed.fail_no_start: This release is paid only once the {days}-day lien period after the event has run ({reference}), and it does not say when that period started
release_period_elapsed.suggestion_no_start: Enter the day the period started, such as the publication date of the certificate of substantial performance, and approve the release again
release_period_elapsed.fail_early: The {days}-day lien period that started on {started} runs until {ends} ({reference}), so this release cannot be approved yet
release_period_elapsed.suggestion_early: Approve the release once the lien period has run, after checking that no lien was preserved against the holdback

document_roles.affidavit_payment_of_debts: affidavit that debts and claims are paid

errors.approval_blocked: This retention release cannot be approved until these are resolved: {findings}
errors.rules_unavailable: The retention release rules are not loaded on this deployment, so this release cannot be checked before it is approved.

g703.billed_not_on_a_schedule_line: Billed work not carried by any schedule of values line

errors.not_active: Change orders are reconciled onto the schedule of values of an active contract only; this contract is {status}
errors.preview_stale: The list of change orders to reconcile has changed since you opened it. Open the preview again and confirm what it shows now

errors.signature_blocked: This contract cannot be signed until these are resolved: {findings}

total_within_contract.fail: The instalments add up to {scheduled}, more than the contract sum of {total}
total_within_contract.suggestion: Reduce the instalments so they add up to no more than the contract sum

percent_sum.fail: The instalments add up to {scheduled} of the contract sum of {total} ({percent}%), so part of the price has no instalment
percent_sum.suggestion: Add an instalment for the rest of the contract sum, or adjust the amounts

completion_trigger_linked.fail: Instalment {milestone} falls due on {trigger}, but it is not linked to a schedule activity, so its date will not move with the work
completion_trigger_linked.suggestion: Link the instalment to the schedule milestone it waits for

schedule_done_plan_pending.fail: The schedule shows {milestone} reached, but instalment {instalment} is still pending, so it cannot be claimed
schedule_done_plan_pending.suggestion: Mark the instalment reached, or check why the contract is not active

client_visible_requires_active.fail: Instalment {milestone} is shown to the client, but the contract is {status}; the client sees the plan of an active or completed contract only
client_visible_requires_active.suggestion: Hide the instalment from the client until the contract is in force

consumer_deposit_cap.fail: The up-front payment of {deposit} is above the {ceiling} that {reference} allows in {jurisdiction} (source: {source_url}, checked {checked_on}, not reviewed by a lawyer)
consumer_deposit_cap.suggestion: Reduce the deposit, or confirm with counsel that an exemption applies to this contract

below_threshold.fail: The contract sum is at or below the amount from which {reference} limits deposits in {jurisdiction}, so the deposit was not checked (source: {source_url})

other_currency.fail: The contract is in {currency}, but {reference} states its limit in {limit_currency}, so the deposit in {jurisdiction} was not checked (source: {source_url})

unchecked.suggestion: If the statute applies to this contract, check the deposit against it by hand

cumulative_exceeds_contract.fail: Work certified to date is {cumulative}, which is {over} above the contract sum of {contract}
cumulative_exceeds_contract.suggestion: Have the change order that covers the extra work approved first, or correct the quantities on this certificate

previous_matches_last_certified.fail: This certificate carries {carried} as the total of the previous certificates, but certificate {reference} was certified at {certified}
previous_matches_last_certified.work_fail: The previous column of the works list adds up to {carried}, but certificate {reference} was certified with {certified} of work to date
previous_matches_last_certified.suggestion: Check for a claim between the two certificates that neither of them shows, then generate this one again

previous_unknown.fail: The total of the previous certificates is not known
previous_unknown.not_certified: The previous certificate {reference} is not certified yet, so its total is not final
previous_unknown.suggestion: Certify the previous certificate first. If it was certified before certificates were stored, enter its total on the previous certificates line

weights_sum.fail: The weights of the items add up to {total}%, not 100%
weights_sum.suggestion: Correct the values of the schedule lines so that their shares add up to the whole contract

percent_regressed.fail: Item {line} is negative this period, so it takes back work that was already certified
percent_regressed.suggestion: Leave it if this corrects an earlier over-measurement. Otherwise correct the quantity or percent on this certificate

income_withholding_single_year.fail: Income withholding is selected, but the contract runs from {start} to {end}, within one calendar year. The withholding concerns construction work that spans more than one calendar year
income_withholding_single_year.suggestion: Check with your accountant whether the work really spans more than one year; if not, mark the income withholding as not applicable

advance_recovery_exceeds_advance.fail: The advance recovered to date is {recovered}, more than the advance of {advance} that was paid
advance_recovery_exceeds_advance.unknown: {recovered} of advance has been recovered to date, but the contract does not state the advance paid, so the recovery cannot be checked against it
advance_recovery_exceeds_advance.suggestion: Lower the recovery on this certificate, or state the advance paid in the contract's certificate settings

retention_matches_config.fail: The certificate holds {certificate} in retention ({percent}% of its base), but the document behind it holds {stored}
retention_matches_config.suggestion: Work the document out again, or correct the retention rate or its base in the contract's certificate settings, so both show the same retention

net_payable_negative.fail: The amount payable is {payable}: the deductions are larger than the amount of this certificate
net_payable_negative.suggestion: Check the deductions, the advance recovery above all, and carry what cannot be deducted now to the next certificate

taxes_stale.fail: The taxes were calculated before this certificate changed, so they no longer belong to it
taxes_stale.suggestion: Recalculate the taxes. If they were already confirmed, reopen them first and confirm them again afterwards

taxes_confirmed.fail: The tax figures of this certificate have not been confirmed
taxes_confirmed.suggestion: Check each tax line and confirm the taxes before certifying

lines_complete.suggestion: Enter the amount, or mark the line as not applicable and say why

work_value_differs.fail: Item {line} is recorded at {stated} to date, but its quantity or percent gives {computed}
work_value_differs.suggestion: Correct the quantity or the amount on the document so that the two columns of the row agree

retention_above_limit.fail: Retention of {percent} percent is above the {limit} percent the public works law allows on each interim payment
retention_above_limit.suggestion: Lower the contract's retention to the statutory rate

advance_above_cap.fail: The advance payment bond covers {percent} percent of the contract value, above the {limit} percent public works allow without the finance minister's approval
advance_above_cap.suggestion: Reduce the advance payment, or record in the contract terms the approval obtained before tendering

delay_damages_uncapped.fail: A delay damages clause has no maximum amount, while the public works law caps delay damages at {limit} percent of the contract value
delay_damages_uncapped.suggestion: Enter the maximum amount of the delay damages clause

delay_damages_above_cap.fail: A delay damages clause is capped at {percent} percent of the contract value, above the {limit} percent the public works law allows
delay_damages_above_cap.suggestion: Lower the clause's maximum amount to the statutory cap

performance_security_missing.fail: No performance security is recorded, while public works require one of {limit} percent of the contract value
performance_security_missing.suggestion: Record the final guarantee as a performance bond or a bank guarantee

performance_security_below.fail: The performance security covers {percent} percent of the contract value, below the {limit} percent public works require
performance_security_below.suggestion: Record a performance security for the full statutory percentage

no_coefficients.fail: Public works of {months} months or more must be price-adjusted by law, and the contract states no coefficients for its variable items
no_coefficients.suggestion: Enter the coefficients the contractor stated in the technical envelope

duplicate_item.fail: The variable item {item} is listed twice among the price adjustment coefficients
duplicate_item.suggestion: Keep one coefficient per variable item

coefficient_not_a_number.fail: The price adjustment coefficient of {item} is not a number
coefficient_not_a_number.suggestion: Enter the coefficient as a decimal, for example 0.15

coefficient_not_positive.fail: The price adjustment coefficient of {item} is zero or less, while the law requires each coefficient to be above zero
coefficient_not_positive.suggestion: Enter a coefficient above zero, or remove the item

coefficient_negative.fail: The price adjustment coefficient of {item} is negative
coefficient_negative.suggestion: Enter a coefficient of zero or more

coefficient_sum_not_below_one.fail: The price adjustment coefficients add up to {item}, while the law requires their sum to stay below one
coefficient_sum_not_below_one.suggestion: Lower the coefficients so that a fixed part of the price remains

coefficient_sum_above_one.fail: The price adjustment coefficients add up to {item}, more than one
coefficient_sum_above_one.suggestion: Lower the coefficients so that they add up to one or less

no_coefficients_advisory.fail: Public works longer than {months} months carry a price revision clause where raw materials are a significant part of the cost, and the contract states no revision weights
no_coefficients_advisory.suggestion: Enter the weights of the revision formula from the special conditions, or record that the price is firm

coefficient_sum_not_one.fail: The price adjustment coefficients add up to {item}, while the formula requires them to add up to exactly one
coefficient_sum_not_one.suggestion: Correct the weights from the contract data so that they add up to one

unknown_regime.fail: The contract names the price adjustment regime {item}, which the platform does not know
unknown_regime.suggestion: Choose one of the listed price adjustment regimes

non_adjustable_portion_out_of_range.fail: The portion not subject to price adjustment, {item}, is not between zero and one
non_adjustable_portion_out_of_range.suggestion: Enter the portion as a decimal from the contract data, for example 0.15

advance_below_minimum.fail: The advance is {percent} percent of the contract value, below the {limit} percent minimum the public works law sets for this contractor and buyer
advance_below_minimum.suggestion: Raise the advance to the minimum, or record zero if the contractor renounced it

advance_above_maximum.fail: The advance is {percent} percent of the contract value, above the {limit} percent the public works law sets as the usual maximum
advance_above_maximum.suggestion: Check that the special conditions allow the higher advance and record the guarantee it requires

delay_damages_rate_differs.fail: A delay penalty clause charges {amount} a day, while the general conditions charge {expected} a day, one {divisor}th of the contract value
delay_damages_rate_differs.suggestion: Keep the general conditions' daily rate, or list the different rate among the derogations of the special conditions

delay_damages_above_general_conditions.fail: A delay penalty clause is capped at {percent} percent of the contract value, above the {limit} percent of the general conditions
delay_damages_above_general_conditions.suggestion: Lower the cap to the general conditions' figure, or list it among the derogations of the special conditions

direct_payment_waived.fail: This subcontract of {amount} reaches the {limit} threshold for direct payment by the public buyer, and the contract waives it, which the law forbids
direct_payment_waived.suggestion: Record that the public buyer pays the subcontractor directly

direct_payment_unstated.fail: This subcontract of {amount} reaches the {limit} threshold for direct payment by the public buyer, and the contract does not record it
direct_payment_unstated.suggestion: Record whether the subcontractor is accepted and paid directly by the public buyer

payment_guarantee_missing.fail: This subcontract on private works records neither a bank guarantee nor a delegation of payment, without which the subcontract can be voided
payment_guarantee_missing.suggestion: Record the main contractor's bank guarantee or the delegation of payment on the owner

private_retention_above_limit.fail: Retention of {percent} percent is above the {limit} percent the law allows on private works
private_retention_above_limit.suggestion: Lower the contract's retention to the statutory ceiling

unknown.fail: Contract {contract} names VAT regime {regime}, which {country} does not have
unknown.suggestion: Choose one of the VAT regimes offered for the project's country, or remove the choice

country_unknown.fail: Contract {contract} names VAT regime {regime}, but its project names no country, so the regime cannot be checked

contract_date_missing.fail: VAT regime {regime} is only for contracts signed before {cutoff}, and this contract records neither a signature nor a start date
contract_date_missing.suggestion: Enter the date the contract was signed

contract_too_late.fail: VAT regime {regime} is only for contracts signed before {cutoff}, and this contract dates from {contract_date}
contract_too_late.suggestion: Choose the standard VAT regime for this contract

evidence_missing.fail: VAT regime {regime} needs {evidence}, and the contract records none
evidence_missing.suggestion: Record the document's reference and issue date with the contract's VAT regime

evidence_date_missing.fail: The {evidence} recorded for VAT regime {regime} has no issue date, so it cannot be shown to predate {cutoff}
evidence_date_missing.suggestion: Enter the date the document was issued

evidence_too_late.fail: The {evidence} recorded for VAT regime {regime} was issued on {issued_on}, and the regime needs one issued before {cutoff}
evidence_too_late.suggestion: Record an earlier document, or choose the standard VAT regime

scope_increase_unjudged.fail: The contract value rose from {original_value} to {current_value} and the contract states no allowed increase, so whether VAT regime {regime} still applies cannot be judged
scope_increase_unjudged.suggestion: Record the increase in scope the contract allows

scope_increase_new_contract.fail: The contract value rose from {original_value} to {current_value}, beyond the {allowed_increase_pct} percent increase the contract allows, so for VAT it is a new contract and VAT regime {regime} no longer applies
scope_increase_new_contract.suggestion: Move the contract to the standard VAT regime

evidence_kinds.main_contractor_certificate: the main contractor's certificate that VAT was paid on the project

not_in_force.before: Claim {claim} is dated {on}, and VAT regime {regime} applies only from {effective_from}; in force that day: {instead}
not_in_force.after: Claim {claim} is dated {on}, and VAT regime {regime} ended on {effective_to}; in force that day: {instead}
not_in_force.suggestion: Change the contract's VAT regime to one in force on the claim date, or correct the claim date
